newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-ADAMS BOWLING AGAIN AFTER THREE-MONTH INJURY LAY-OFF.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ADAMS BOWLING AGAIN AFTER THREE-MONTH INJURY LAY-OFF.

text.p: South African left-arm wrist spinner Paul Adams took four wickets on his return for Western Province after a three-month injury lay-off in their Supersport Series four-day match against Boland at Newlands on Thursdy.

Adams took wickets with the seventh and 17th balls of his comeback from shin and groin injuries and later returned to claim two more to finish with figures of four for 68 from 23 overs -- the best of the innings.

Adams had been asked by the national selectors to prove his fitness in the game and may now be added to the South African tour party which begins a three test series against India in Ahmedabad on November 20.
Adams played his last first class game at the beginning of August during the South African A team's tour of England.
